name: ce.breakpoints
description: Manage generation-bound Windows hardware breakpoints. The source per-breakpoint callback returns 1 to wait; the global callback default 0 is valid. Hits are history, not current stop context: use fresh status and stopGeneration guards. Remove logically releases the handle and requests native disable; native list deletion may be deferred. Do not repeat removal based on native list presence. Remove only owned breakpoints, then detach; status and cleanup remain available.

action.description: Remove only an owned logical handle and request native disable. Native list deletion may be deferred; do not repeat removal merely because the native list still contains the address.
